location_fine: run-down village house and grass field
visual_synopsis: A long-haired village man in a blue work shirt hauls buckets around a half-ruined breeze-block house and runs through a tall green field swinging a scythe, breaking off constantly to talk straight into the camera like a documentary subject. His wife and two young sons stand watching by the doorway, the wife gives her own piece to camera indoors in front of a wall carpet, and a light blue Lada rolls past the field.
